title: Spoken Team Assistant
subtitle: It answers a spoken question with a short reply out loud and posts the full written answer in the right chat room.
lede: It answers a spoken question with a short reply out loud and posts the full written answer in the right chat room. It can move between rooms, address a teammate, start a panel discussion or hand heavy work to a stronger model.
who: A manager who would rather talk than type
group: Meetings, voice and the AI colleague
author: Corey James
